$comment: Vendoring metadata for exchange_calendar_snapshot.json. The snapshot stays byte-for-byte; this file records where it came from and when to review it. Read by tools/check_snapshot_freshness.py. refresh_cadence is monthly, quarterly or yearly, and review_by = vendored_at + 1 cadence period (1, 3 or 12 calendar months, same day of month, clamped to the month's last day).
